base_url.description: Base URL for the Passbolt instance. Can also be provided via `PASSBOLT_URL` environment variable.

passphrase.description: Passphrase for the user's private key. Can also be provided via `PASSBOLT_PASS` environment variable.

private_key.description: ASCII-armored PGP Private key of Passbolt user. Can also be provided via `PASSBOLT_KEY` env var.

block.description:
The Passbolt provider allows you to manage secrets, folders, users, groups, and permissions in your self-hosted Passbolt instance using Terraform.

It supports both **Passbolt CE and PRO**, and is integration-ready for AWS SSM, Secrets Manager, and other external secret stores.

Authentication is performed using your PGP private key and passphrase, which can be provided directly or via environment variables.

folder_parent.description: Reference to the parent folder. Accepts a unique folder name, a folder UUID, or an absolute path such as `/application_A/prod`. If omitted, the folder will be created at the top level.

folder_parent_id.description: Resolved UUID of the parent folder.

id.description: The UUID of the Passbolt folder.

metadata_type.description: Optional metadata format for this folder. Use `v5` to create or migrate the folder to encrypted metadata, `v4` to force legacy cleartext metadata on create, or leave unset to use the Passbolt server default without migrating existing folders.

metadata_type_actual.description: Actual remote metadata format for this folder: `v4` or `v5`.

name.description: Name for the folder. Must be unique among sibling folders.

personal.description: Whether Passbolt currently treats the folder as personal, meaning it is not shared.

block.description:
Creates a folder in Passbolt. Folders are used to organize secrets and can be shared with groups using the `passbolt_folder_permission` resource.

Folders can optionally have a parent folder (nesting is supported).

folder_id.description: The UUID of the Passbolt folder to be shared. This folder must already exist.

group_name.description: The name of the Passbolt group to grant access to. The group must already exist.

id.description: Internal resource ID, always in the format `folder_id:group_name`. Used to uniquely track the sharing link between a folder and a group.

permission.description:
Level of access to grant. Must be one of: `read`, `update`, `owner`, or `delete`.
	- `read`: read-only access
	- `update`: ability to edit contents
	- `owner`: full control (admin rights)
	- `delete`: used internally to revoke permissions (not typically used manually)

block.description: Grants a Passbolt group permission to access a specific folder. This resource allows sharing a folder with a group with a defined level of access. To revoke access, simply remove the resource from your configuration.

ignore_inactive_members.description: When true, inactive regular members that are not yet part of the group are skipped with a warning instead of failing the apply. Terraform will continue to plan those memberships until the users become active. Group managers remain strict and must already exist and be active in Passbolt.

managers.description: List of user IDs to assign as group managers. Users must already exist and be active in Passbolt.

members.description: List of user IDs to assign as regular group members. Users must already exist and be active in Passbolt.

block.description: Creates and manages Passbolt groups. Groups can be assigned managers and used to share resources like passwords or folders. Passbolt requires the authenticated API user to be a group manager when changing memberships on an existing group. Group memberships also require existing active Passbolt users; users created by passbolt_user may need to be activated before they can be referenced from passbolt_group in a later apply.

folder_parent.description: Name or UUID of an existing folder to place the secret in. Leave unset to place at top level.

id.description: The UUID of the Passbolt password/secret resource. Used for import and internal tracking.

metadata_type.description: Optional metadata format for this password. Use `v5` to create or migrate the password to encrypted metadata, `v4` to force legacy cleartext metadata on create, or leave unset to use the Passbolt server default without migrating existing passwords.

metadata_type_actual.description: Actual remote metadata format for this password: `v4` or `v5`.

name.description: Name for identifying the password/secret in Passbolt.

password.description: Legacy secret input. Marked sensitive and masked in CLI output, but still stored in Terraform state for drift detection. Use `password_wo` when you do not want Terraform to persist the secret value.

password_wo.description: Write-only secret input. Terraform does not persist this value in plan or state files. Set `password_wo_version` and increment it whenever you want to rotate the secret.

password_wo_version.description: Version tracker for `password_wo`. Terraform stores this value in state so you can trigger password rotation by incrementing it. Required when `password_wo` is configured.

share_group.description: Name of the Passbolt group to share this secret with. Leave unset to keep private.

share_groups.description: List of Passbolt group names to share this secret with. Supports multiple group shares. Takes precedence over `share_group`.

uri.description: The URI or URL where the secret is used (e.g., https://service.example.com).

username.description: Username or login for the password/secret entry.

block.description: Manages a secret/password entry in Passbolt. Supports optional folder placement, group sharing, Passbolt v4 and v5 encrypted metadata resources, and both legacy stateful passwords and write-only password workflows.

first_name.description: First name of the user. Required for creation, but not returned by the API when reading the user.

last_name.description: Last name of the user. Required for creation, but not returned by the API when reading the user.

block.description: Creates and manages a Passbolt user. Users can be assigned roles (`admin` or `user`) and added to groups. Users created by this resource may not be immediately available for passbolt_group memberships; activate them in Passbolt before referencing them from passbolt_group in a later apply. This resource is useful for automation of onboarding, role enforcement, and group membership.

created_by.description: User ID that created the folder.

folder_parent_id.description: UUID of parent folder (if any), or empty if top-level.

modified_by.description: User ID that last modified the folder.

personal.description: True if folder is a personal folder (not shared).

folders.description: List of folders in Passbolt account.

block.description: Fetches all folders in Passbolt, including details like name, parent, timestamps, and ownership. Useful for discovering folder structure...

name.description: Name of the group to look up.

block.description: Fetch a Passbolt group by name.

folder_parent_id.description: Parent folder's UUID containing this password/secret.

id.description: The Passbolt resource UUID (you can get it from the Passbolt UI or list of resources).

name.description: Name of the password/secret in Passbolt.

password.description: The **actual secret value**. Sensitive values are masked in CLI output, but Terraform will still persist the decrypted value in state.

uri.description: URI where the password is used, e.g., a service address.

block.description: Fetch a password/secret from Passbolt by its ID. Useful for lookups in cross-team automation or outputting secrets to other modules. Supports Passbolt v4 and v5 encrypted metadata resources. Returns all metadata and the decrypted secret value. The decrypted value remains sensitive in Terraform output, but Terraform will still persist it in state.

active.description: Whether the Passbolt user has completed activation.

include_inactive.description: When true, allows returning an inactive, non-deleted Passbolt user. This only affects the data source lookup. To skip inactive users during group membership apply, use the returned ID as a regular passbolt_group member with ignore_inactive_members enabled.

role.description: Role of the user: admin or user.

username.description: Exact username (email address) to look up. The user must already be active unless include_inactive is enabled.

block.description: Looks up an existing non-deleted Passbolt user by exact username (email address). By default, only active users are returned.
